description: Awarding Procurements for the operation of travel service counters at the Arrival Lobby of the Bandaranaike International Airport, Katuynayake
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-08-24 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Bids have been invited following the National Competitive Bidding Procedure to select suitable institutions for the operation of 06 Travel Service Counters in the Arrival Lobby of the Bandaranaike International Airport, Katunayake. Ten (10) bids have been submitted for the same. The proposal made by the Minister of Ports and Civil Aviation to award the said procurements for a period of 03 years as follows, based on the recommendations submitted by the Standing High Level Procurement Committee, after evaluating the said bids, was approved by the Cabinet: Travel service countersRecommended BidderContract Value Rs. million (Excluding Tax)10M/s Casons Travel (Private) Ltd251.0311M/s J N W Lanka Tours209.6712M/s Awavia Tours (Private) Ltd189.6613M/s Ceylon Arrivals (Private) Ltd183.6014M/s Ayubowan Tours & Travels (Private) Ltd171.5315M/s Explore Vacations and Travels (Private) Ltd234.73
